mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 32 degree temperatures at Reddan Soccer Park, feeling like 26 under a waning crescent moon.
The city is gearing up for pavement repairs on November 10 and 11, affecting areas like North Nine Mound Road and Morningside Boulevard, so please note the no-parking signs from 7 AM to 7 PM.
There is plenty to do with the Dane County Farmers Market today, live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Paddy Mac's today, plus trivia events scheduled for November 11 and 12.
In a notable incident on October 25, Verona police arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I after he was discovered unresponsive in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
The flavor of the day is Andes Mint Avalanche. The store is currently closed, but will open today at 10:00 AM.
